gates.purpose: Selected declarations pass schema and cross-reference validation.
Every selected repository ref is bound to a verified immutable commit.
Required non-secret configuration is present without conflicts.
Required external secret references resolve for only their intended consumers.
All selected required components satisfy their declared readiness gates.
Selected authoritative state is mounted or restored consistently and passes owner checks.
Application-owned migrations and integrity checks completed for the resolved versions.
Authentication, retrieval/business authorization, and scoped service contracts pass.
Derived indexes and caches are rebuilt or reconciled from authoritative state.
Core can submit consistent backup sets using a separate bounded backup identity.
A policy-required rollback backup exists and verification evidence is current.
Backup repository integrity and capacity checks pass.
Reviewed retention and protected-copy policy is active.
Restore access is separate from backup submission and requires explicit authorization.
Human, application, backup, monitoring, administration, and management identities remain distinct.
Selected exposure is explicit and within component and profile limits.
Kal's bounded self-health contract passes.
RAG indexing status is durable across restart and reconciliation behavior is validated.
Beepy's bounded self-health contract passes.
The selected model-runtime implementation satisfies its bounded capability health contract.
Monitoring collection operates without exposing sensitive values.
The outbound backup client can perform its bounded function.
The backup target service is functioning independently of restore authorization.
An explicitly selected private overlay transport is healthy.
The explicitly enabled legacy UI compatibility integration is bounded and healthy.
The explicitly approved temporary lab exposure integration is healthy and authenticated.
